description.p: A two-pane archive manager written in pure Rust. Browse your files on the left and the contents of an archive on the right, without Wine, Qt or an external 7z process.

ul.li: Read and write 7z, zip, tar, tar.gz, tar.xz, tar.bz2 and tar.zst
Browse archive contents in-app, preview text files and hex dumps
Extract everything or only the selected item
Test archive integrity and inspect properties

description.p: First packaged release: two-pane browser, 7z/zip/tar read+write, RAR reading, in-app viewer, 2026-style icon set.
